subject: Web Development
title: The Psychology of Waiting
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Psychology of Waiting.

hook.text: Humans perceive anything under 100 milliseconds as instant. Our brains can't detect it.

buildup.text: After one second, users notice the delay. After three seconds, they consider leaving.

discovery.text: Progress indicators trick the brain into patience. Spinners buy time that blank screens can't.

twist.text: Perceived performance matters more than actual speed. Skeleton screens feel faster than they are.

climax.text: Web performance is as much psychology as engineering — fool the brain and users stay.

punchline.text: Feeling fast matters more than being fast.

quiz.question: At what delay do users notice a page is slow?
